candidates.change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = address(0);' so that setOwner never updates the owner to the caller-provided address.
Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' which does not change the owner value, but the change in return value is an externally visible behavioral difference after a call to setOwner.
Replace 'require(msg.sender == admin, ...);' with 'require(msg.sender == owner, ...);' changing the access control so that only the current owner (not admin) can change owner.
Delete the require statement from the onlyAdmin modifier, removing the access check so anyone can call setOwner.
Delete the 'onlyAdmin' modifier from setOwner, allowing any caller to change the owner.
Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so the function always returns false instead of true.
Delete the return statement so the function returns the default bool value (false) instead of true.
Remove the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so anyone can change the owner.
Replace owner = _owner with a no-op so owner never changes.
Replace owner = _owner with owner = address(0) so owner becomes zero address.
Replace owner = _owner with owner = admin so owner becomes admin.
Replace the onlyAdmin require condition with require(true) so it always passes.
Delete the require statement in onlyAdmin so modifier body is empty, always passing.
